advanced.d3dxIntervalButtonTip: If game is running, click to send F10 reload and apply new flush interval immediately
advanced.d3dxIntervalTip: Controls how frequently 3DMigoto flushes in-memory persistent skin variables to d3dx_user.ini in background. Lower values make ModDeck detect ingame hotkey switches faster. Changes write directly to d3dx.ini. If game is running, reload with F10 once; also takes effect on next game launch.
advanced.desc: Configure in-game Quick Overlay, 3DMigoto reload hotkeys, auto-switch strategies, and sync timing.
advanced.f10BufferButtonTip: Measure reload duration during live gameplay and auto-calibrate ideal buffer
advanced.f10BufferTip: Internal ModDeck timer applied in memory immediately without requiring F10 or game restart. Wait buffer after F10 reload for shader compilation and render frame transitions before flushing persistence and clearing bridges. For large mod libraries, set higher or use Benchmark Calibration.
advanced.modalReloadF10Desc1: You have disabled automatic reload for presets. Selected skin variables are written to the central bridge, but
advanced.modalReloadF10Desc2: the game screen requires a reload to apply
advanced.modalReloadF10Desc3: • Recommended method: Summon the floating quick overlay via hotkey (default {hotkey}), then click 'Reload F10 / Apply Now' at the bottom. ModDeck initiates safe buffer sync and clears pending indicators.
advanced.modalReloadF10Desc4: • Physical F10 note: Pressing physical keyboard F10 triggers graphics reload directly, but due to Windows process isolation, summoning the overlay to click Reload is recommended to keep UI indicators fully in sync.
advanced.reloadHotkeyDesc: Default F10. Click the input box and press a key to rebind.
advanced.switchBatchDesc: Default OFF. Prevents frequent frame stutters when batch toggling multiple mods.
advanced.title: Advanced Settings

general.autoReloadRosterPreset: Auto reload after switching full roster schemes
general.autoReloadRosterPresetDesc: Automatically reloads game when switching full roster schemes for instant team outfit change.
general.autoSaveIntervalDesc: 💡 Controls how often 3DMigoto automatically flushes in-memory variables to d3dx_user.ini. Writes directly to d3dx.ini. Requires F10 reload while game is running.
general.autoSaveIntervalOpt10: 10s (Fastest sync, recommended when using in-game hotkeys)
general.autoSaveIntervalOptDisabled: -1 (Disable timed save, saves on exit or F10)
general.behaviorDesc: Control 3DMigoto reload hotkey, preset auto-reload policy, and auto-save interval.
general.closeBehaviorDesc: Choose action when closing main window. Minimizing keeps hotkeys and Quick Overlay active.
general.languageDesc: Choose interface language. Supports Simplified Chinese, English, and external locales/ packages.
general.manualReloadAlertText1: You have disabled auto reload for some presets. Stylistic variables are pre-written to bridge, but in-game screen still requires a reload to display.
general.manualReloadAlertText2: • Recommended way to apply: Press hotkey in-game to bring up overlay, then click 'Reload F10 / Apply Now' button at bottom (displays pulsing '● Apply Now (N)' when presets are pending).
general.manualReloadAlertText3: • Physical F10 Explanation: Pressing physical F10 directly will change outfits in game immediately, but ModDeck UI state won't guess physical keypress due to Windows process isolation. Use overlay button for full UI synchronization.
general.openLanguagesFolderTip: Open languages folder to inspect or add custom language JSON files
